taxonomy.note: Current Kew accepts the species and four infraspecific varieties, including var. patens.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: UT Plant Resources Center Williamson County flora includes Symphyotrichum patens var. patens. Kew confirms Texas nativity at species level, but B090 did not lock two additional exact target-zone counties.
target_zone_range.blocking_issue: Need two more exact target-zone counties matching the current concept.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not turn an eastern-Texas/ecoregion range map into county records.

morphology.look_here_first: Upright late-blooming purple aster with rough hairy stems and rough-textured leaves that often clasp the stem.
